deadline.value: The department's application instructions say December 1 (year not shown); its FAQ page and the Graduate Division directory give December 2, 2026. Aim for December 1.

gre_general.value: Not stated on the pages checked

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: Admission is by committee; students rotate through at least three research groups before choosing an advisor.
supervisor.quote: Students are required to survey at least three groups by attending, at minimum, three of their group meetings before selecting a research advisor.

funding.value: All students in good standing are supported by a teaching assistantship, research assistantship or fellowship.
funding.quote: All graduate students in the Department who are in good academic standing and making normative progress toward the Ph.D. are financially supported by a teaching assistantship, graduate student research assistantship or fellowship.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree with a GPA of 3.0 or above is the minimum; there is no separate master's route and students are admitted to the PhD only.
entry_route.quote: Bachelor’s Degree or its equivalent from an accredited university prior to the quarter for which the applicant seeks admission

also.quote: Students are accepted into the Ph.D. program, only.

notes: International TAs must pass an oral English exam after admission. The department FAQ also lists 'a country where the official speaking language is English' as a TOEFL exemption, which differs from the Graduate Division's WHED rule; check with the department.
